title: add-runtime-nvtx-counters-microbench-and-perf-dashboard-enhancements
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: We need higher-fidelity runtime telemetry and a lightweight microbenchmark harness to iterate on kernel/scheduler/KV-cache changes with low turnaround. This PR adds NVTX ranges for key runtime stages, a small family of atomic counters for hot paths, new microbench workloads for continuous-batching and KV cache behavior, and a perf dashboard that aggregates the new signals.

What this PR does: - Adds NVTX ranges around packetization, kernel dispatch, KV cache lookup/hit/miss, and async IO stalls. - Introduces runtime counters (lock-free where possible) for: kv_hits, kv_misses, batch_formation_ms, kernel_dispatch_ms, io_wait_ms, kv_evictions. Counters exposed via /metrics and our internal telemetry ingestion. - Implements a small microbench harness under runtime/microbench/ that can drive synthetic workloads (short/long context, prefix caching, concurrent streams) and emit structured traces + counter snapshots. - Adds Grafana dashboard and prebuilt panels under observability/perf/dashboards/nvtx-counters.json and wiring to the perf ingestion job. - Small refactors to the scheduling hot path to surfaced timing hooks; no behavior changes. - Adds smoke and integration tests for counters and microbench harness.

Checklist: [x] Add NVTX ranges for hot paths [x] Add counters and metrics export [x] Add microbench harness and test workloads [x] Add dashboard and example queries [x] Update docs/observability.md with new counters [x] CI green including perf smoke tests

Testing and validation: Unit + integration tests cover counter semantics and microbench runner. Ran microbench locally and on perf lab with 3 seeds. Results are in the perf dashboard link below. Observed ~8-12% P99 latency improvement in a continuous-batching scenario after later tuning (follow-up PR), and stable KV cache hit/miss counts across runs.

Migration notes: Counters are additive and optional; they default to enabled. Backward-compatible: NVTX ranges are no-op when NVTX is not linked. Dashboard is additive.

Rollout plan: Merge to main behind feature flag telemetry.experimental=true; enable for perf lab and canary fleet before enabling org-wide.

References: Linear ENG-3421 (runtime telemetry), ENG-3578 (perf harness), incident SUP-1123 for a customer-facing cache regression that motivated faster iteration.

release_notes: Add NVTX ranges and runtime counters for scheduler/kernel/KV-cache; include microbench harness and perf dashboard. Feature gated under telemetry.experimental. Intended to improve performance visibility and speed up kernel/scheduler iteration.
performance_results: continuous-batching P99 latency: baseline 120ms -> with follow-up tuning 106ms (~11.7% improvement)
throughput under synthetic short-context workload: +40% when microbench-informed scheduler tweaks applied (follow-up tuning)
